Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the specific fix: Series.replace with cudf.NA on a bool column. The raw summary confirms the change in _normalize_find_and_replace_input in numerical.py and a bool replacement test, so the title matches the main change. It is concise and uses the fix: prefix.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description states the root cause, the fix, and the test added. It matches the changeset: the all-null list normalization in _normalize_find_and_replace_input, the column_empty replacement for astype, and test_series_replace_bool_with_na. It also links issue `#24894`.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** [`#24894`] Requirement: native cuDF `Series.replace({False: cudf.NA})` must turn matching `False` values into missing values. Root cause: in `_normalize_find_and_replace_input` (python/cudf/cudf/core/column/numerical.py), an all-null list was cast with `astype(input_column_dtype)`. For bool, the string-to-bool cast filled nulls with `False`, so the replacement value was `False`. The diff replaces that cast with `column_empty(len(normalized_column), dtype=input_column_dtype)`, which builds an all-null column of the input dtype. `column_empty` is imported in the same file. The non-list paths are unchanged. The new test `test_series_replace_bool_with_na` (python/cudf/cudf/tests/series/methods/test_replace.py) checks `Series([False, True]).replace({False: na})` and `.replace(False, na)` for `na` in `[cudf.NA, None]`. Both checks expect `[None, True]` with dtype bool, which matches the replaced-value requirement. The requirement covers the element value, not the pandas result dtype, and the test asserts against the cuDF expected series. I did not execute the test suite. This verdict rests on reading the diff and the test.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The whole-PR diff against the merge base changes two files. python/cudf/cudf/core/column/numerical.py has a 3-line change that replaces the all-null `astype` with `column_empty`. This directly implements `#24894`. python/cudf/cudf/tests/series/methods/test_replace.py adds one parametrized regression test for the same issue. No unrelated code, configuration, or documentation changes appear in the diff. The `astype` method itself is not modified, as the PR description states.
